description:
An auditor has requested evidence for the 'Information Backup' control. You need to upload the backup log to the corresponding Compliance Analysis record in Eramba.

1. Go to Compliance Management > Compliance Analysis.
2. Find the analysis for 'A.12.3.1 - Information Backup'.
3. Upload the file '/home/ga/Documents/Evidence/Backup_Log_Sept2025.pdf' as an attachment to this record.

The file is already prepared in your Documents folder.
